policy: Validate vertex/topology hash, original UVMap, transforms and per-face source material NAME. Source slot indices are deliberately absent; compact R24 local slots are supported. Existing geometry and UVMap remain unchanged. Only final used new UV layers and changed-face material references are supplied. No sequential R26/R27/R28 installation required.
excluded: R25/R26 new geometry and R29 replacements are delivered separately by the integrator. R21_04 old grillage is excluded because the R29 retained-geometry display supersedes it.
delivery: One copy per real PNG hash, lightweight material library using relative Textures paths. No packed image duplication. Keep library and Textures folder together.
URP_limitations: Not a ready-made Unity shader. Use BaseColor as sRGB; masks as linear; import tangent maps as normal maps (+Y; importer handles convention). Bind atlas and detail UVs explicitly. Built-in shader UV choices may be insufficient; reproduce the stated multi-UV formulas in the established local shader, or rebake to its supported channels. UVMap is existing UV0, preserve it; new layers must not overwrite lightmap channels. Blender loop indices require source importer/mesh-corner correspondence, never direct Unity vertex indexing. Axis conversion, tangent handedness and mesh export remain the established local pipeline responsibility; no runtime or visual-equivalence validation claimed.
normal_tangent_basis: The normal tangent basis must follow the UV used by the normal map: R26 micro normal uses existing UVMap; R27 macro normal uses R27_Industrial_Finish_UV; R28 macro/detail have matching orientation and use their named UVs. A Unity importer that generates tangents only from a different UV channel is not equivalent. Rebind/regenerate the appropriate tangent basis through the established source export pipeline; preserve mirrored-axis handedness once.
portable_json_authority: This external JSON is the authoritative delivery mapping, including semantic texture roles. Embedded blend text is informational; shader node connections are unchanged.
